_doc: US fuel and water prices for the Water Engine cost metric (James, 2026-10-25 06:53 PDT: judge gains on cost too). Every price has a source URL and the date it refers to; all were fetched 2026-10-25 ~07:00 PDT. Retail for road fuels; alcohols are wholesale (no national retail neat-alcohol price exists) - so absolute $/mile is NOT comparable across fuels. The primary metric is the % change vs the same fuel's dry baseline, which only depends on the water/fuel price ratio.

gasoline_regular.basis: US retail national average, regular unleaded (in practice E10)
gasoline_regular.cross_check: EIA weekly US regular retail 4.284 USD/gal, week of 2026-10-19 (https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/gasdiesel/, released 2026-10-20)

diesel.basis: US retail national average, diesel (reference only; no diesel fuel is modelled)
diesel.cross_check: EIA weekly US on-highway diesel 6.276 USD/gal, week of 2026-10-19

methanol.basis: Methanex North America Non-Discounted Reference Price (wholesale contract), valid 2026-10-01..2026-10-31, posted 2026-09-29

ethanol.basis: USDA AMS National Weekly Ethanol Report, Iowa ethanol plant FOB truck average, week 2026-10-19..2026-10-23 (wholesale fuel ethanol; denaturant ignored)
ethanol.source: USDA AMS Livestock, Poultry & Grain Market News report 3616

cng.basis: US national average retail CNG, Clean Cities Alternative Fuel Price Report July 2026 (latest quarterly issue; prices reported 2026-07-01..31). 1 GGE of CNG = 5.660 lb (NIST Handbook 44 Appendix D). Methane (CH4) is priced as CNG.
cng.source: US DOE Alternative Fuels Data Center
cng.gge_source: NIST Handbook 44, Appendix D (gasoline gallon equivalent, CNG = 5.660 lb)

water_distilled.basis: Retail distilled water, Great Value 1 gal jug (conservative: bulk deionised/tap water is far cheaper; the free-water bound is also reported)

fuel_to_price_note: PRF87/PRF91 surrogates of US regular and E10 are priced as AAA regular (US regular is E10); PRF97 (premium surrogate) as AAA premium; E85 as AAA E85.
